newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK, S. Korea sign pact on investment protection.
newsitem.headline: HK, S. Korea sign pact on investment protection.

text.p: Hong Kong and South Korea on Monday signed an agreement on investment promotion and protection, local government said.

Under the pact, the two administrations will provide investors with equal treatment, compensation in case of investment expropriation, and free-transfer of investments and returns, the Hong Kong government said in a statement.
It will also provide for the settlement of investment disputes in accordance with internationally accepted rules.
South Korea the is 10th largest foreign investor in Hong Kong, which is in turn South Korea's sixth largest source of foreign investment, the statement said.
The latest agreement is the 13th that Hong Kong has signed in the area of investment promotion and protection with other countries, the statement said.
South Korean Foreign Minister Yoo Chong-ha, who signed the accord for his country, was in Hong Kong to witness its handover from Britain to China at Monday's midnight ceremony, the statement said.
